warning.titlePre: Jaguar S-Type 4.2 V8 Timing Chain Stretch
paragraphs: The S-Type 4.2 V8 uses the AJ-V8 engine. Across its production run, this engine is known for timing chain stretch, typically between 80,000–150,000km, signalled by a cold-start rattle. The chain tensioners and guide rails wear alongside the chain. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guide rails, and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (AutoDoc, LR Engine Specialists), per VRF-jaguar-s-type.md. This claim applies to the AJ-V8 4.2L engine.
